preconditions.description: The input text contains at least one character other than a newline.

preconditions.expression: all(32 <= ord(char) <= 126 for line in input_text.splitlines() for char in line)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input text are within the range of 32 to 126 inclusive.
The input text ends with a newline character.

postconditions.description: The output text contains at least one character other than a newline.

postconditions.expression: all(32 <= ord(char) <= 126 for line in output_text.splitlines() for char in line)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output text are within the range of 32 to 126 inclusive.
The output text ends with a newline character.
Each line in the output text contains at least one non-space character.

postconditions.expression: all(not line.startswith('#') for line in output_text.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: All non-amplifying lines in the output text do not start with '#'.

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('#') or not line.strip() != '' or (i > 0 and output_text.splitlines()[i-1].startswith('#') and output_text.splitlines()[i+1].startswith('#')) for i, line in enumerate(output_text.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Empty lines are preserved if surrounded by amplifying lines, otherwise they are concatenated with adjacent non-amplifying lines.
